name: DODO
fix_description: In init, the function is external without any access control or initialization guard. Anyone can call init to re-initialize the DVM pool with malicious token addresses, then drain the pool funds. Fix: add initializer modifier or require(!initialized) check to prevent re-initialization.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-callback flash-loan exploit where the attacker simply calls an unprotected or improperly validated init() during the loan and then transfers out the borrowed assets. It requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning, no complex routing or pricing logic, and the PoC is far under 100 lines.
